Dixidae.notes: 2 pairs of ventral prolegs on abdominal segments A1 and A2

Simuliidae.notes: 1 anterior thoracic proleg + 1 posterior anal sucker/proleg

Blephariceridae.notes: 6 pairs of lateral prolegs, one per body division

Rhagionidae (Vermileoninae).notes: Single unpaired ventral proleg on first abdominal segment
